rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the Senate's session of 1 October 1992 the Senate approved urgency request nº 732/92 and then the opinion (Parecer nº 302, de 1992, dated 30 September) of its Special Committee concluding that the process for crime of responsibility against President Collor should be instituted and that he should be summoned to present his defence; the President of the Senate announced that the Mesa would meet to serve notice on the President and to communicate with the Vice-President, with the President of the Supreme Federal Court to preside over the process.

locator.item: Requerimento nº 732/92; Parecer nº 302, de 1992; continuation on printed page 7902

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 only. Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Vice-presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded except the Vice-President's exercise of the office, recorded as rows only.
